text:
alex: Heads-up — starting a per-tenant canary for ACME (dedicated) that isolates 5% of their traffic to a new routing policy. Need consensus on isolation guards and quota fallback.

maria: what's the isolation surface? CPU/GPU pool pinning or network isolation?

alex: pool pinning + soft quota cap. Plan: route 5% traffic to model v2 on dedicated pool A, with a hard token cap per minute and automatic fallback to v1 if latency > 800ms or error rate > 1%.

sophia: please add tenant-level circuit breaker to avoid cascading. Example policy I used elsewhere:

```
{
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "slice": "canary-2026-03",
  "traffic_pct": 5,
  "pin_pool": "dedicated-pool-a",
  "token_quota_per_min": 20000,
  "failure_threshold": 0.01,
  "latency_slo_ms": 800,
  "fallback": "v1"
}
```

ryan: +1 on circuit breaker. Also suggest isolation of KV-cache namespaces so cache poisoning doesn't affect prod.

alex: good call. Would adding a soft throttle at edge (429s) help? We don't want silent queueing.

maria: yes, edge throttle + metric export. Q: telemetry — what dashboard will show per-tenant canary health?

pm-oliver: product needs a per-tenant canary view in Console. Minimal: traffic split, error rate, p50/p95 latency, tokens consumed, fallback events. Can we emit events for each fallback decision? (so we can audit)

alex: we already emit rollout.events.* in telemetry, but not per-tenant. I'll file a task to tag rollouts with tenant_id.

sophia: small API debate — should canary config be part of the tenant routing API or a separate rollout API? If part of tenant routing, edge reads fewer sources. If separate, it's cleaner for A/B tests.

ryan: leaning toward separate 'rollout' resource: /tenants/{id}/rollouts so we can attach audit metadata and versions.

alex: agreed. Also need quota isolation: per-tenant reserved tokens on dedicated pools so other tenants can't steal capacity. Put a floor for producer tenants.

maria: ops concern: how will we schedule canaries on the same physical machines? We need node anti-affinity label 'canary' to keep them off busiest nodes.

alex: will add label proposal to deployment PR. Also: deploy-bot triggered.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for tenant acme -> model v2 on dedicated-pool-a (slice canary-2026-03). ID roll-7891.

pm-oliver: we'll monitor dashboards and decide after 4 hours. If fallback events > 10 in rolling window -> rollback.

sophia: add one more guard: blocklist per-tenant on the fallback path to prevent twice-failing circuits.

ryan: I'll make a small PR to add per-tenant KV namespace isolation and export fallback_count metric as rollout.events.fallback_count.

alex: thanks. Action items: alex - add tenant tag to telemetry and create rollout API spec; ryan - PR for kv isolation & fallback_count metric; maria - deployment anti-affinity labels; sophia - circuit-breaker config snippet; oliver - monitor and decide after 4h. :thumbsup: 

alex: cool. I'll post the rollout API spec in #eng-platform-docs and link here.

maria: thanks, will stand by on infra changes.
